items.description: Create a canonical Managed Image from one fresh one-shot staged PNG ref. PNG alpha and original bytes are preserved. No paths, file URLs, base64 or replacement pixels. Use MCP-native transfer_inbound_artifact as the normal inbound path; get_connection_status inboundStaging and raw STDIN remain the supported CLI compatibility/diagnostic adapter. Existing staging limits apply. Defaults: centered anchors, zero offsets/rotation/cornerRadius, opacity 1, overflow false, next zIndex, intrinsic longest side clamped to 120...420 points. size is the longest displayed side in Canvas points; aspect ratio is preserved. Stage refs are checked after context/revisions and consumed only after commit; failed preparation never creates a placeholder. Post-commit cleanup may remain pending internally; never replay a successful or uncertain mutation.

placement.description: Partial Image placement. A changed anchor resets its omitted matching offset to zero; unchanged anchors preserve omitted offsets; an explicit offset wins.

items.description: Duplicate one existing committed Group using exactly groupID. Shipper duplicates supported members by automatic +24/+24, generates every UUID, and returns authoritative Group and member mappings. Do not send delta, offset, members, newGroupID, temporaryID, or correlationID.
Canonical Group delta shape: exactly groupID, deltaX, and deltaY. Do not send delta:{x,y}.
Canonical Canvas alignment shape: references plus horizontal and/or vertical; at least one anchor field is required. Do not send anchor or alignment objects.

Duplicate unique existing Text, Symbol, Illustration, Drawing, or Managed Image references atomically. Managed Image duplication requires valid package bytes, creates a new UUID/package identity with byte-equivalent content, applies +24/+24 Canvas points, preserves zIndex and semantic state, and does not copy Group membership. Read source-to-duplicate mappings from duplicatedElements; duplicates are usable only in a later mutation.
Canonical explicit-reference delta shape: exactly references, deltaX, and deltaY. Do not send delta:{x,y}.

Transfer the exact Shipper TextStyleSnapshot from one existing Text to unique existing Text targets. Preserves content, layout, position, identity, Text rotation, fitToOneLine, lineLimit, and zIndex; copies every foreground/background gradient stop without a two-stop projection.
Update one existing Managed Image. Missing fields preserve exact current values. Identity, bytes, displayName, contentType, naturalWidth, and naturalHeight are read-only.

set_screenshot_source.description: Safe committed Screenshot Source result. screenshotSource.id is session-scoped Canvas-slot identity; checksum is canonical content identity. consumed/pending apply to staged one-shot artifacts; not_applicable identifies an authorized reusable source with no staging artifact. pending is a successful mutation with internal cleanup still pending, never a mutation failure.

items.description: Path-safe Screenshot Source diagnostic. interactive_edit_in_progress includes every active privacy-safe blockingStates category. Typed codes include project_revision_conflict, canvas_revision_conflict, canvas_not_found, staged_source_not_found, staged_source_expired, staged_source_consumed, staged_source_wrong_session, staged_source_wrong_activation, staged_source_busy, checksum_mismatch, authorized_source_not_found, authorized_source_stale, authorized_source_changed, screenshot_folder_not_configured, screenshot_folder_stale, screenshot_folder_unavailable, authorized_source_validation_failed, unsupported_media, normalization_failed, preparation_context_changed, interactive_edit_in_progress, undo_unavailable, revision_tracking_unavailable, strict_commit_refused, validation_failed, and no_screenshot_source_change.

projectLifecycle.description: Enumerate known native catalog candidates without acquiring authority or reading packages. A candidate is not AVAILABLE. Use name as an exact discovery filter for named intent; Core computes global EXACT_UNIQUE/AMBIGUOUS before pagination. Empty projects with null nextCursor means no matches. For browsing follow opaque nextCursor, preserving name; stale/invalid cursors fail explicitly. Do not reuse old candidateRefs after fresh enumeration; refs/cursors expire after 120 seconds or catalog incarnation changes. No paths, bookmarks or project UUIDs. Never choose an ambiguous row by order, recency or focus. Shipper must already be available.
projectLifecycle.name: list_projects

projectLifecycle.description: Acquire and open one exact Core-issued lifecycle-03 candidateRef from list_projects. Candidate references select an existing source, never constitute authority; old authorizedProjectRef arguments are rejected. No path, URL, filename, bookmark or project UUID is accepted. Core revalidates access/resource/project and verifies the registered session; existing hosts are reused and other dirty projects preserved. OPENED binds this MCP helper to the returned project/session; inspect_project then reads that context, regardless of focus. Accepted downstream operations use the verified exact project/session independently of focus, while retaining their normal admission, ID and revision checks. USER_ACTION_REQUIRED does not automate permission. After an uncertain open, do not blindly replay: list_projects again, resolve and verify the intended host. No app launch, content mutation or Shipping is performed.
projectLifecycle.name: open_project

projectLifecycle.description: Use to create one durable native blank Shipper project in the configured Projects folder. Generate a lowercase UUID creationAttemptID BEFORE dispatch. It is correlation only, never project or permission authority. NEW explicit create intent uses a new ID; retry/reconciliation of the SAME uncertain attempt MUST reuse the same ID and canonical name, including after timeout or reconnect. Do not substitute a fresh ID to retry; never adopt by name, and never blindly create again. No receipt means a new intent; retired IDs refuse. Unknown provenance, unavailable receipts, changed intent, name conflicts and UNRESOLVED must stop creation. Preserve any published package. OPENED binds exact project/session for inspect_project. Allow Codex to connect must be ON; no chooser, app launch, design, localization or shipping.
projectLifecycle.name: create_project

shipping.description: Prepare Core-owned Shipping evidence; ASC GETs and private local assets only, no remote writes. Default/infer derives existing categories and compatible project specifications through Core. Poll the same preparation arguments while preparing; never execute before prepared. Review exact locales, field facts, replacement counts and blockers. Metadata is category-level with the existing six-field rules; field filters are rejected, never silently ignored. Screenshot destinations are resolved independently per locale: one available specification per ASC display type, with Portrait preferred only when both orientations are available. Explicit single-orientation intent is preserved and unavailable explicit orientation blocks rather than being substituted. Use exact project/session authority. Reuse the same operation reference to observe uncertain results; do not replay the Ship. MCP OFF closes all tools; after re-enabling MCP observe the same operation. Publishing OFF permits observation only. No caller approval, credentials, Target overrides, raw effects or retry flags. No App Review, release, build or TestFlight. Repository Plugin Shipping orchestration is available; installed acceptance is separate.
shipping.name: prepare_shipping

shipping.description: WRITE: dispatch one exact prepared operation or its exact Core-issued continuation. Returns bounded state while work continues. A lost or uncertain response may mean dispatch occurred: observe_shipping with the SAME operationRef; never automatically prepare again or replay the whole Ship. An opaque ref locates evidence, not permission. Use exact project/session authority. Reuse the same operation reference to observe uncertain results; do not replay the Ship. MCP OFF closes all tools; after re-enabling MCP observe the same operation. Publishing OFF permits observation only. No caller approval, credentials, Target overrides, raw effects or retry flags. No App Review, release, build or TestFlight. Repository Plugin Shipping orchestration is available; installed acceptance is separate.
shipping.name: execute_shipping

shipping.description: READ: observe one known operation and bounded asynchronous read-only reconciliation; never dispatch recovery. Poll while executing/reconciling. Preserve UNKNOWN if reconciliation is unavailable. Only execute a returned opaque continuation explicitly; all live mutation authority is rechecked. Use exact project/session authority. Reuse the same operation reference to observe uncertain results; do not replay the Ship. MCP OFF closes all tools; after re-enabling MCP observe the same operation. Publishing OFF permits observation only. No caller approval, credentials, Target overrides, raw effects or retry flags. No App Review, release, build or TestFlight. Repository Plugin Shipping orchestration is available; installed acceptance is separate.
shipping.name: observe_shipping

target.description: Read the exact project's safe persisted Target association and persistence state. No ASC, Keychain, selection or save. Always unverified; this also reconciles an uncertain refresh/bind. Reconciliation does not prove remote freshness. Exact projectID/projectSessionID are required; no focus fallback. Reuse returned IDs and expectedContext only while that project/session and local context remain current. Do not claim verification from a standalone read. Target has no PRO gate. Target context is separate from Screenshot Specs, metadata, localization and Shipping. Never treat persisted context as remotely fresh. Process one intentional Target flow at a time. If the user changes Target, stop and reobserve their current choice.
target.name: read_target_context

target.description: Discover/refresh through Core and the native session owner. For an associated Target, refresh its exact ASC ID; do not supply a different candidateAppID. For an unbound project optionally supply exactAppName OR an observed candidateAppID, plus an intended versionID when needed. Exact case-sensitive unique name only; no fuzzy matching or first result. Discovery never binds a new app. CANDIDATE_OBSERVED_NOT_BOUND and observedCandidate describe this operation's remote observation, not verified project association. candidates/versions are the native loaded scope (at most 200), not exhaustive account discovery. Existing associations may refresh locally. Bind only observed exact IDs with returned expectedContext. Security authorization may require the user; never loop or bypass. After uncertainty, read_target_context before deciding further work; never automatically replay. Exact projectID/projectSessionID are required; no focus fallback. Reuse returned IDs and expectedContext only while that project/session and local context remain current. Do not claim verification from a standalone read. Target has no PRO gate. Target context is separate from Screenshot Specs, metadata, localization and Shipping. Never treat persisted context as remotely fresh. Process one intentional Target flow at a time. If the user changes Target, stop and reobserve their current choice.
target.name: refresh_target_context

target.description: Explicitly bind observed exact ASC appID/versionID, with expectedContext copied from the last Target observation. Core revalidates IDs, versions and local revision/association using the existing credential/session owner. No binding by name or caller trust flags. Success returns actual context, operation-scoped verification and native persistence status; verified does not mean saved. On an uncertain response, do not replay: read_target_context and reconcile. Exact projectID/projectSessionID are required; no focus fallback. Reuse returned IDs and expectedContext only while that project/session and local context remain current. Do not claim verification from a standalone read. Target has no PRO gate. Target context is separate from Screenshot Specs, metadata, localization and Shipping. Never treat persisted context as remotely fresh. Process one intentional Target flow at a time. If the user changes Target, stop and reobserve their current choice.
target.name: bind_target
